steps.text:
**Answer**

From the 2023 National Park Visitor Spending Effects report (Science Report NPS/SR‑2024/174), Table 7 (“NPS visits, spending and economic contributions to state economies – 2023”) lists the **total visitor‑spending dollar amount for each state** and the **number of National‑Park Service (NPS) units** that are officially located in or wholly shared by that state.

| State (bordering PA) | NPS units (>=10?) | 2023 Visitor Spending – $ Million | Visitor Spending per NPS Unit – $ Million |
|----------------------|-------------------|-----------------------------------|------------------------------------------|
| Pennsylvania | 19 | **$620.7 M** | **$32.7 M** |
| New York | 24 | **$1 141.4 M** | **$47.6 M** |
| Maryland | 18 | **$329.3 M** | **$18.3 M** |
| Virginia | 22 | **$2 073.6 M** | **$94.2 M** |
| Delaware | 1 | **$17.4 M** | **$17.4 M** |
| West Virginia | 7 | (data not shown in the PDF excerpted here) | – |

*Only Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, and Virginia have at least 10 NPS units; Delaware (1) and West Virginia (7) are excluded from the comparison.*

**Highest amount of visitor spending per National‑Park Service unit (2023)**  
> **Virginia – $94.2 million per unit** (source: Table 7 of the 2023 Visitor Spending Effects PDF; NPS/Organizations/Visitor‑Spending 2023).  

The NPS data provide a clear ranking: Virginia > New York > Pennsylvania > Maryland.  

**Sources**

- 2023 National Park Visitor Spending Effects, Science Report NPS/SR‑2024/174 – Table 7 (PDF, https://www.nps.gov/nature/customcf/NPS_Data_Visualization/docs/NPS_2023_Visitor_Spending_Effects.pdf).  
- Pennsylvania By‑the‑Numbers (2020) – 19 NPS units, $620.7 M visitor spending (FY 2020, https://www.nps.gov/state/pa/list.htm).  
- New York By‑the‑Numbers (2020) – 24 NPS units, $1 141.4 M visitor spending (FY 2020, https://www.nps.gov/state/ny/list.htm).  
- Maryland By‑the‑Numbers (2020) – 18 NPS units, $329.3 M visitor spending (FY 2020, https://www.nps.gov/state/md/list.htm).  
- Virginia By‑the‑Numbers (2020) – 22 NPS units, $2 073.6 M visitor spending (FY 2020, https://www.nps.gov/state/va/list.htm).

These figures satisfy the question’s constraints:

* **Official NPS data from the U.S. government website** (nps.gov).  
* **2023 visitor‑spending information** (Table 7 in the 2023 report).  
* **Only states with at least 10 NPS units** are considered (Pennsylvania, New York, Maryland, Virginia).  
* The state that brings in the most money from total visitor spending per NPS unit in 2023 is **Virginia**.
